items.raw_excerpt: A new service is bringing a doctor closer to First Nation communities, helping break down barriers to health care and enabling patients like Melanie Kahmahkotayo to get help for conditions like diabetes. items.summary_en: Chile's central bank presented new 10 and 50 peso coins on Wednesday. The new coins keep the current design and value, but weigh less because they are made with a cheaper production method. They will gradually join circulation together with existing coins.
